title: Welcome to the Redemption Hackers Recovery & Blockchain Blog
seo_description: An introduction to practical blockchain tracing, scam prevention, evidence documentation and lawful cryptocurrency recovery options.
content:
Cryptocurrency recovery starts with understanding the transaction history and preserving reliable evidence. This blog will explain practical topics such as blockchain tracing, address analysis, exchange reporting, evidence organization and scam prevention.

Every case is different. A transaction that can be followed on a public blockchain does not automatically mean that funds can be recovered. The useful goal is to establish a clear factual record and identify legitimate next steps.

Never share a seed phrase, private key, password or two-factor authentication code with a recovery service. Legitimate assistance should not require control of your wallet credentials.

Future articles will focus on education and lawful options rather than promises of guaranteed results.
